scenarioTitle: Maintain Source and Workflow Health — connector resilience

successCriteria.text: At-least-once delivery reduces to exactly-one effect: a re-delivered event never produces a second governance effect.

lines.assertionText: Given a connector or controller misses health expectations, When degradation is detected, Then ownership, affected scope, last success, failure, retry state, business impact, and safe next action are visible and alertable.

evidence.detail: a transient outage retries under the SAME idempotency key with bounded backoff; a terminal class and an exhausted budget both STOP (no retry storm)
a terminal message is PRESERVED (payload + sha256 digest), attributed to an owner, with business impact + a safe next action (authorized replay) — nothing dropped (FR-030)

lines.assertionText: Given duplicate or out-of-order source updates, When reconciliation runs, Then no duplicate governance action occurs and source history remains reconstructable.

evidence.detail: at-least-once reduces to EXACTLY-ONE effect: a re-delivered batch is a no-op — the ingestion content digest is byte-identical whether the batch arrived once or twice (SC-011)
source history is RECONSTRUCTABLE: rebuilding the projection from the preserved append-only raw log in a DIFFERENT arrival order reproduces the same content digest (deterministic view)
duplicate + out-of-order + gap + drift are SURFACED as named findings (never silently applied, never auto-filled)

lines.assertionText: Given conflicting source states, When authority rules cannot resolve them, Then the conflict remains visible, affected automation pauses safely, and an owned issue is opened for human resolution.

evidence.detail: drift-visible honesty: a clean run reports resolved=true; a run with conflicting drift enumerates every drift item and reports resolved=FALSE (the conflict stays visible, never elided) (FR-029)
affected automation PAUSES SAFELY rather than looping: an unresolvable (terminal) failure stops instead of retrying, and the dead-letter record is the owned issue opened for human resolution
witnessed: owned issue: deadLetter held for owner=dced11e2-5bae-710e-b526-97e3a9856d9b, replayState=held until authorized
